summary.goal: Define Zod schemas for the Understanding section - free-form agent observations captured during ideation
summary.context: Understanding captures what specialist agents notice as they watch conversations. It's exploratory, keyword-based, and preserves the 'why' behind planning decisions. Each role (architect, designer, tester, security) has their own observations.

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentObservationsSchema defined with: observations[], keywords[], questions[], concerns[], references[], confidence, updated_at, updated_by
UnderstandingSchema is Record<string, AgentObservations> allowing any role key
All fields are optional for incremental population
TypeScript types exported for frontend use

steps.description: Create src/domain/understanding.ts with Zod schemas for AgentObservations and Understanding

acceptance_criteria.description: AgentObservationsSchema with optional fields: observations: z.array(z.string()), keywords: z.array(z.string()), questions: z.array(z.string()), concerns: z.array(z.string()), references: z.array(z.string()), confidence: ConfidenceSchema, updated_at: z.string().datetime(), updated_by: z.string()
